simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שֶׁגֶר (H7698) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שֶׁגֶר (sheger) means the fœtus (as finally expelled ) First listed occurrence: Deut 7 13.

definitions.full: H7698. sheger שֶׁ֫גֶּר noun [ feminine Albr ZAW xvi (1896), 70 ] offspring, young of beasts ( שגר id. Ecclus 40:19; compare We Skizzen iii. 170 ); — construct ׳שׁ ; — שׁ ׳כָּלמֶּֿטֶר בְּהֵמָה Exod 13:12 (J; ׳כָּלטֿ רֶחֶם precedes); also אֲלָפֶיךָ שְׁגַר Deut 7:13 ; 28:4 , 18 , 51 (all || צאֹנֶ֑ךָ עַשְׁתְּרֹת ). שַׁד , II. שֹׁד breast , see שׁדה .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root probably meaning to eject ;
